art_direction: 浅藕纸底柔琥珀双眼，下弧饱满，清醒正视。
composition_variation: Use comfortably open bowls, the right about ten percent wider and the left visibly lower and fifteen percent less open. The dark upper lids should have a soft shallow arch rather than a straight edge. Both large black pupils face forward and touch those lids. Matching amber bands stay broad along the lower curves, accompanied by one long narrow ivory glint in each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
